hyperedges.label: Reducing dictation wait under CPU load

nodes.label: Adaptive state polling (120 ms live / 500 ms idle / 2 s hidden)
nodes.norm_label: adaptive state polling (120 ms live / 500 ms idle / 2 s hidden)
nodes.rationale: Window used to redraw 8x a second even when hidden, costing most of a CPU core and slowing transcription; put() skips DOM writes when values are unchanged.

nodes.label: Wispr Flow transcript as reference
nodes.rationale: Word errors are counted against Wispr Flow's transcript of the same recording, giving a ground truth on the maintainer's own voice.

nodes.label: v1.1.0 (instant typing, 3 s context)
nodes.rationale: Instant typing and locking in finished words with 3 s of context; accuracy 5.9% on 40 recordings.

nodes.label: v1.1.1 (short dictations whole at release)
nodes.rationale: Short dictations transcribed whole at release cut word errors 54 -> 42 vs pause-only pieces; hook skips SpeakOn's own keystrokes; mouse hook only when needed.

nodes.label: v1.2.0 (mic kept ready with lead-in)
nodes.rationale: First word kept 57/60 when mic starts 300 ms early vs 43/60 when 60 ms late, so the mic is kept ready with a 0.5 s lead-in; edits that add words are no longer learned as corrections.

nodes.label: v1.2.1 (sound-alike snapping fixes, idle polling fix)
nodes.norm_label: v1.2.1 (sound-alike snapping fixes, idle polling fix)
nodes.rationale: Sound-alike snapping wrongly rewrote correct text (e.g. 'trading session' -> TradingView); clean-up step went 10.01% -> 9.22% on 671 Wispr texts. Settings window polled 8x/s even when hidden, costing ~77% of a core idle -> ~6%.

nodes.label: v1.2.2 (above-normal CPU priority while dictating)
nodes.rationale: With every core busy, waits dropped 3.05 -> 1.37 s; priority returns to normal as soon as text is written so the PC is not starved otherwise.

nodes.label: Sound-alike snapping
nodes.rationale: Dictionary words catch sound-alikes, but must not swallow small words ('on TradingView') and ordinary words must never snap to targets.
